Job Description:

Summary:

Are you ready to dive into the exciting realm of hands-on operations, project involvement, and groundbreaking research that drives cost savings and revenue opportunities for Avery Weigh-Tronix? If you're a student eager to make a mark, we want you on our team. 
We are looking for Software Engineering Interns to help with new product development and testing this summer. Our team of Software Engineers will be mentoring these individuals and setting them up for success. We're searching for a customer-focused, self-directed, results-oriented individual who thrives in collaborative environments.


What We Are Looking For

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS/REQUIREMENTS:  

  • Pursuing a bachelor’s degree Software, Electrical, or Computer Engineering. 
  • Currently enrolled with a minimum of two years completed towards degree. 
  • Self-directed, results-oriented and customer-focused
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office/Teams
  • Proactive in recognizing improvement opportunities is necessary
  • Strong organizational, interpersonal, and written and oral communication skills

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS/SKILLS:  

  • Desire to obtain a career in Software Engineering after graduation. 
  • Great communication skills, collaboration, enjoy a team setting.

Pay Range: $17.80 - $25.65

At Avery Weigh-Tronix, we're not just offering an internship – we're inviting you to make an impact, shape innovations, and take your skills to the next level. Your voice matters, your ideas count, and your growth is our priority. Join us, and let's create something extraordinary together.
